description: This file implements the feature for creating comments within a Conduit application. It includes command definitions, validation logic, and a request handler to process comment creation, associate it with an article and the current user, and persist it to the database.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains the data structures, validator, and handler for creating comments.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Validates that the comment body is not empty.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the creation of a new comment, associating it with the article and author, and persists it.
